clauses.text:
Section 1. Establishm ent, (a) There is established the President’s Task Force  
on Food A ssistance, which shall be composed of not more than fifteen  
persons, who shall be appointed by the President from among citizens of the  
United States who are not full-time officers or employees of the Federal  
Government.

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text:
(b) The President shall designate a Chairman, and m ay also designate a Vice  
Chairman, from among the members of the Task Force.

clauses.label: Sec. 2.
clauses.text:
Sec. 2. Functions.  The Task Force shall analyze Federal and other programs  
intended to render food assistance to the needy and shall make recom m enda­
tions to the President and the Secretary of Agriculture with respect to how  
such programs m ay be improved. The Task Force shall submit its report to the  
President within ninety days of its first meeting.

clauses.label: Sec. 3.
clauses.text:
Sec. 3. Adm inistration, (a) The heads of Executive agencies shall, to the extent  
permitted by law, provide the Task Force such information as it m ay require  
for purposes of carrying out its functions.

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text:
(b) M embers of the Task F oice shall serve without com pensation for their  
work on the Task Force, but m ay be allowed travel expenses, including per  
diem in lieu of subsistence, as authorized by law  for persons serving intermit­
tently in the Government service (5 U.S.C. 5701-5707), to the extent funds are  
available therefor.

clauses.label: (c)
clauses.text:
(c) The Secretary of Agriculture shall, to the extent permitted by law  and  
subject to the availability of funds, provide the Task Force with such adminis­
trative services, facilities, staff and other support services as m ay be neces­
sary for the effective perform ance of its functions.

versions.research_rationale: EO 12439 (Sept. 8, 1983; 48 FR 40871) established the President's Task Force on Food Assistance under FACA; its eight operative subsections all concern the Task Force. Section 4(b) ends it 'thirty days after submission of its report to the President, but in no event later than January 31, 1984'; the report was due within ninety days of the first meeting (sec. 2). No amendment exists. The Task Force therefore ended on or before January 31, 1984, but the exact date depends on when the report was submitted (if more than thirty days before January 31, 1984, the end is earlier), which no held source records. Every clause is terminated; the first-end date is left open rather than set to the outer limit. The draft's FULL_AND_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT is resolved by reading EO 12534 sec. 3, which revokes each listed order as a whole; the 'partial' reading came only from the OFR catalog's acting-order phrasing 'Revokes advisory committees established by'. No human certification is asserted.

savings_residuals.reason: Neither EO 12439 nor the revoking EO 12534 contains a savings clause, and EO 12534 sec. 3 states that the committees it lists had already terminated. Members served without compensation (travel expenses only), and the Agriculture support and FACA delegation in secs. 3(c) and 4(a) applied only to the Task Force. No rights, entitlements, property, delegations or functions outside the body itself were created, so nothing survives its termination; reimbursements and support given while it existed are completed transactions, not continuing effects. Bounded search: the full original order, every amending and continuance order named in this claim, and EO 12534.

unresolved_material_gaps: ending_or_current_basis: the first end of every clause (and so whole_order_end) is not established. Sec. 4(b) ends the Task Force thirty days after it submitted its report, and in no event later than January 31, 1984; the outer limit is known, the actual date is not. No held source records the date the report was actually submitted, and a reporting deadline is not evidence of that date. EO 12534 sec. 3 (effective 1985-09-30) is a cleanup revocation of a body it describes as already terminated, so it cannot be used as the first end. Needed: an official record of the report's transmittal date (for example the Weekly Compilation of Presidential Documents or the report itself), queued through FETCH_QUEUE.jsonl.
claim.research_rationale: EO 12439 (Sept. 8, 1983; 48 FR 40871) established the President's Task Force on Food Assistance under FACA; its eight operative subsections all concern the Task Force. Section 4(b) ends it 'thirty days after submission of its report to the President, but in no event later than January 31, 1984'; the report was due within ninety days of the first meeting (sec. 2). No amendment exists. The Task Force therefore ended on or before January 31, 1984, but the exact date depends on when the report was submitted (if more than thirty days before January 31, 1984, the end is earlier), which no held source records. Every clause is terminated; the first-end date is left open rather than set to the outer limit. The draft's FULL_AND_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT is resolved by reading EO 12534 sec. 3, which revokes each listed order as a whole; the 'partial' reading came only from the OFR catalog's acting-order phrasing 'Revokes advisory committees established by'. No human certification is asserted.
